settings.title: Project Settings
settings.previewDeviceHelp: Device used when previewing cues with the headphones button.
settings.ltcDeviceHelp: Device used to send LTC timecode (optional).
settings.outputTargetHelp: Sets the meter standard, waveform colours, and loudness-match target for this project.
settings.meterModeHelp: Unit shown on all stereo meters.
settings.meterBallisticsHelp: How fast the meters rise and fall.
settings.autoTrimSilenceOnImportHelp: Automatically trims leading and trailing silence from newly imported audio. Volume is unchanged.
settings.autoMatchLoudnessOnImportHelp: Uses measured integrated loudness to set newly imported audio to the selected output target. Trim points are unchanged.
settings.autoReduceTruePeaksOnImportHelp: Turns down newly imported audio only when needed to keep its measured true peak at or below the project's active limiter ceiling. Audio is never boosted.
settings.disableLimiterHelp: Turns off the true-peak limiter, allowing reconstructed waveform peaks above the output ceiling.
settings.disableSilenceWarningHelp: Stops the silence warning banner from appearing in the header.
settings.transitionModeHelp: Transition applied to newly imported tracks. Each track can still be switched between cross-fade and start-next in its properties.
settings.autoCueNext: Automatically cue next item even without end behaviour
settings.autoCueNextHelp: Arms the next item as "Up Next" even when the playing item has no end behaviour, so you can step through the playlist with a single GO button. It does not start playback automatically.
settings.stopAllFadeHelp: How long all cues take to fade out when you press Stop All. Set to 0 for an instant stop.
settings.scrollToPlayingHelp: Automatically keep the currently-playing item centred in the list.
settings.indexDisplayStartHelp: Controls the number shown for the first playlist item. Internal indexes and API index paths remain zero-based.
settings.playlistTrackHeightHelp: Adjusts playlist row height on this Mac. Narrow layouts may need extra height to keep every control visible.
settings.waveformOpacityHelp: Controls how strongly waveforms appear in playlist tracks on this Mac.
settings.cycleTrackColorsHelp: Assigns palette colors in order to newly imported tracks. Existing track colors do not change.
settings.cartPlayerLayoutHelp: Total cards applies in every mode and window. Loaded or shortcut-assigned cards set the minimum so reducing the total never hides them. Columns set cards across; rows set how many rows the cart tries to show at once; height is the minimum card height.
settings.countdownColorsHelp: Changes the Time Left clock color at each remaining-time range.
settings.countdownThresholdInvalid: Use a unique whole number of 1 second or more.
settings.countdownSaveFailed: The countdown color settings could not be saved.

sessionRecovery.projectChangedHint: Use server project discards the unsaved local edits. Restore local project explicitly replaces the server’s active project with this one.
